title: Doctoral INPhINIT Fellowships Incoming
field: Technology, engineering, physics, chemistry, mathematics, life and health sciences (per the 2026 rules)
about: The "la Caixa" Foundation's Doctoral INPhINIT Fellowships Incoming support early-stage researchers starting a doctorate at accredited research centres in Spain or Portugal. The Foundation's listing shows the call open until 12 January 2027 at 2 pm Peninsular Spain time.
requirements: Host must be an accredited Spanish centre (Severo Ochoa, Maria de Maeztu, Carlos III Health Institute) or a Portuguese R&D unit rated excellent by FCT (per the 2026 rules)
Within the first four years of full-time research experience at the deadline; not previously enrolled in a doctoral programme (2026 rules)
Mobility rule: no more than 12 months of residence or main activity in the destination country in the last three years (2026 rules)
